new_jobs.title: Senior Retail Operations Executive
new_jobs.jd: **About Us** **Who we are:** Since 1975, TUMI has been creating world-class business, travel and performance luxury essentials, designed to upgrade, uncomplicate, and beautify all aspects of life on the move. Blending flawless functionality with a spirit of ingenuity, we’re committed to empowering journeys as a lifelong partner to movers and makers in pursuit of their passions. The brand is sold globally in over 75 countries with approximately 2,000 points of sale. **Job Description** Key Responsibilities * Oversee daily operational processes, including administrative workflows, office management, store support, and vendor coordination. * Drive operational excellence across stores by standardizing and optimizing SOPs. * Support store teams in operational execution, ensuring alignment with company standards and business objectives. * Coordinate cross-functional tasks with Finance, HR, IT, and external vendors. * Manage contracts, documentation, expense claims, and internal approval processes. * Monitor store operations and proactively identify areas for improvement. * Handle urgent operational issues (e.g., maintenance, logistics, or store-related incidents) in a timely manner. * Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and local regulations. * Support new store openings, relocations, and renovation projects when required. * Provide administrative and operational support to drive overall business performance. * Improvement in store operational efficiency and execution standards * Timeliness and accuracy of administrative processes * Effectiveness of SOP implementation and optimization * Response time and resolution of operational issues * Cross-functional coordination efficiency * Cost control and operational expense management Key KPIs * Improvement in store operational efficiency and execution standards * Timeliness and accuracy of administrative processes * Effectiveness of SOP implementation and optimization * Response time and resolution of operational issues * Cross-functional coordination efficiency * Cost control and operational expense management **Requirements** * 3–5 years of experience in retail operations, preferably within premium or lifestyle brands * Positive, proactive, and can-do attitude, with willingness to go the extra mile when needed (e.g., supporting systems such as Xstore, WMS, OMS) * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with frontline teams and understand their needs * Ability to support marketing administrative tasks when required (approximately 85% retail operations and 15% marketing/CRM support) * Strong organizational and multitasking skills * Excellent communication and coordination abilities * Detail-oriented with strong execution capability * Ability to work under pressure and adapt to a fast-paced environment * Proactive mindset with strong ownership **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in retail or luxury industry is a plus * Familiar with SOP development and process optimization * Experience supporting multi-store operations Competencies * Execution & ownership * Problem-solving and analytical thinking * Time management and prioritization * Stakeholder management * Adaptability and resilience **About The Team** **Why you'll love working here:** At TUMI, you’ll find a dynamic working environment, joining a community where each team member is empowered with an entrepreneurial spirit. Associates are respected as a vital part of the organization and recognized for their contributions. We believe in a workplace that gives every individual the opportunity to make an impact, and our ongoing commitment is to provide all the tools you need to succeed— guidance towards individual career growth, professional training and development initiatives, and a motivating, exciting environment— along with competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits programs. **What We Value** * INNOVATIVE BY NATURE. SUSTAINABLE BY CHOICE. TUMI protects the things that matter most, the things you own and the planet you travel to see. Our planet is an astonishing place and we believe it’s our responsibility to preserve it for travelers of the future. By putting excellence and quality first, we ensure that every TUMI product has lifelong purpose, supported by our rigorous testing standards, exploration of recycled materials, and global repair network. * PARTNERS WE BELIEVE IN. Staying true to our values by helping take care of the most vulnerable among us aligns with our mission and is a core element of what we do. We focus on three main areas: promoting wellbeing; empowering vulnerable communities; and protecting the earth’s beautiful places. Each year we extend our philanthropic efforts to partners that help better the world. From supporting St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital fight to cure childhood cancer to Waves for Water who provides clean water to communities in need, we proudly stand by the profound changes they enact. * CULTURE & INCLUSION. As an organization, we are committed to a diverse and vibrant culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers each of us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day. The actual rate of pay offered depends on various factors, including qualifications for the position and relevant experience; as well as other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position or location. Tumi is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

new_jobs.jd: 隨著企業數位轉型的步伐加快，AI automation 應用技術已成為提升效率和競爭力的重要工具。Aiworks 致力於幫助企業客戶培育 AI automation 專業人才及提供顧問陪跑計劃，幫助企業解決導入人工智慧和自動化流程所遇問題，成功提升自動化技能並推廣至工作場域。 同時，Aiworks 也於 2026 年正式成為 **OpenAI Advanced Partner** ，持續協助台灣企業推動 AI 導入與應用落地。 **【Why Join Us?】** 在 Aiworks，你不只是執行專案，而是企業數位轉型的推手、組織的策略夥伴！ 你將與團隊一同探索最新 AI／自動化應用，並有機會與專業人才與合作夥伴攜手，運用 AI 自動化技術重構企業關鍵營運與流程，協助客戶加速數位事業、透過創新推動成長並創造實質影響力。 我們正在尋找一位 **AI 自動化應用顧問** ，以專業與親和力協助企業梳理業務流程，設計適切的 AI 自動化解決方案，如果你對 AI、以使用者為中心的設計，以及 幫助他人解決問題 充滿熱情，我們誠摯邀請你加入我們的團隊！ **【工作內容】** * 解決方案導入與企業賦能 * 情境診斷： 針對企業潛在需求，進行 AI 自動化應用情境分析與效益評估，建立客戶對技術落地的信心（需 pre-sales）。 * 流程重塑： 協助客戶梳理業務流程，設計客製化 AI 自動化解決方案，並參與 AI 自動化初期開發與諮詢，確保方案具備可執行性。 * 培訓體系規劃： 策劃系統化的「企業陪跑計劃」，針對種子學員設計分階段培訓與實作指導，確保 AI 技能於企業內部紮根與內化。 * 專案管理與產品推進 * 需求洞察： 深度訪談利害關係人，轉化客戶痛點為產品優化動能，確保功能設計符合非技術背景使用者的操作直覺與價值預期。 * 端到端專案控管： 精確定義專案範疇 (Scope) 與時程，監控成本、品質與風險，透過糾正措施確保專案如期達成關鍵指標 (KPI)。 * 變革推動： 跨部門協調解決執行阻礙，建立標準化教學文件與示範流程，降低產品採用門檻，加速企業內部的數位變革。 **【需求特質 / 經歷】** * 具 5 年以上專案軟體 PM or 2B 顧問服務經驗，擅長跨部門協調、利害關係人溝通、推動組織變革，能整合多方需求推動專案執行。 * 個性主動、充滿好奇，能快速理解不同行業的業務流程與工作狀況，並以簡單明瞭的方式解釋複雜的技術概念。 * 為 AI 自動化工具重度使用者！熟悉至少兩個主要的 AI 工具或自動化平台（例如：ChatGPT、Gemini、NotebookLM、Copilot、Claude⋯⋯）等內容生成工具、協作與知識管理工具、資料與 API 自動化工具。 * 良好的溝通能力，能夠同理使用者痛點，對於解決使用者問題抱持熱誠，並且能了解關係人不同立場，提出適合解方。 **【加分項目】** * 具有教學 / 協助他人（例如：同事、企業或朋友）使用 AI 工具之經驗 * 具有使用者流程訪談、梳理之經驗 * 具有軟體工程師背景 **【應徵方式】** 請將個人履歷投遞至 Aiworks 職缺申請表單，我們將優先進行履歷審核。 合適者將於兩週內進行聯繫。

new_jobs.title: Consultant (OpenShift/K8S, AI)
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for an OpenShift and AI Consultant to join us in Taipei, Taiwan. In this role, you will be a key driver in architecting and implementing enterprise-scale container solutions for our customers. You will not only apply your deep technical expertise in Red Hat OpenShift but also act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through their digital transformation journey. As a Consultant, you will lead modern cloud-native development. You will design and deploy sophisticated OpenShift environments, mentor customer teams, and ensure the successful adoption of DevOps and GitOps practices. Your work will have a direct and measurable impact, helping our customers build resilient, scalable, and secure application platforms. You should be a motivated leader with exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for open source technology. If you are ready to take on complex challenges and help shape the future of hybrid-cloud computing, we want to hear from you. What you will do * Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor for Red Hat OpenShift Container and AI Platform (OCP/AI) at the client site, addressing strategic IT needs and complex technical challenges. * Design, create, and deliver content that enables the broader Red Hat organization to design, service, and support our Automation solutions at scale. * Lead complex Red Hat Consulting engagements, taking ownership of the full project lifecycle from design and architecture to successful implementation. * Design and implement sophisticated OpenShift & Virtualization solutions that integrate with a customer's existing infrastructure, including networking, storage, security, and identity management. * Mentor and guide customer teams on best practices for containerisation, application deployment, and OpenShift administration. * Provide technical leadership and hands-on support for OpenShift and AI solution upgrades, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. * Proactively identify and mitigate project risks, keeping stakeholders informed of progress and potential issues. * Advanced knowledge of Red Hat AI solutions is preferred. What you will bring * Background in architecting and designing complex customer solutions in a rapidly evolving technology domain. * Extensive experience as a consultant or architect, with a strong focus on cloud-native and container technologies. * Deep, hands-on expertise with OpenShift Container Platform (or K8S) and AI skills, including installation, configuration, and day-2 operations. * Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and core concepts such as pods, services, deployments, and operators. * Candidates who are good with prompts, RAG, model training, model distillation/quantization, MCP, and AI agent development; this AI-related knowledge is excellent. * Expertise in designing and implementing solutions with a focus on high availability, scalability, and security. * Experience with DevOps and GitOps practices and related tools (e.g., Ansible, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton) is a plus. * Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts, including networking, storage, and virtualisation. * Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Bash, Ansible). * Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving critical issues. * Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration/Development is highly desirable, with the willingness to pursue other relevant certifications. * Strong background in consultative customer engagement with either a major consulting services organization or within the services division of a major software company. * It’s a plus if the candidate is also familiar with the Red Hat Satellite product. **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. **Inclusion at Red Hat** Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. new_jobs.title: AI Creative Producer
new_jobs.jd: AI Creative Producer Full-time | Taipei, Taiwan | Hybrid Monthly salary: NT$40,000–70,000, depending on relevant skills and experience. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for someone with creative curiosity, strong judgment, and high standards who wants to turn ideas into compelling commercial content using generative AI. You will develop concepts and produce visual content for products and brands, with hands-on video creation as a central part of the role. Projects may vary in category, length, and format. You will help us build commercial samples and develop a reliable production workflow as we explore a new creative service. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Turn briefs into original concepts, scripts, storyboards, and visual directions suited to the audience and purpose. • Use generative AI and editing tools to produce and finish videos and other visual assets. • Review outputs critically and improve storytelling, pacing, consistency, natural movement, product accuracy, and sound. • Experiment with new tools and approaches, compare results, and document useful lessons. • Respond thoughtfully to feedback and take ownership of revisions and delivery. • Track production time and tool costs, propose focused tests when paid resources are needed, and work within approved budgets. • Create samples and assets that help the sales team demonstrate our capabilities. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Creative drive: you actively develop ideas and make things, rather than only discuss them. • Creative judgment: you can explain why an idea or visual choice works for a particular product, audience, or message. • High standards: you notice weaknesses, make deliberate improvements, and know when a result still falls short. • Learning ability and resourcefulness: you independently explore unfamiliar tools, solve problems, and apply what you learn. • An interest in hands-on video production and a willingness to develop your skills through practice and feedback. • Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and comfort working in a team where the creative process is still evolving. Relevant backgrounds may include advertising, directing, filmmaking, screenwriting, design, animation, editing, or self-directed creative projects. We welcome different paths into this work; a specific degree, traditional job title, or fixed number of years is not required. LEARN WITH US Experience with AI creative tools is helpful, but an established multi-tool workflow is not a hiring requirement. Our founder is willing to teach you how to combine tools and develop the production process. We place particular value on attitude, learning ability, creative judgment, and the pursuit of excellence. WORK ARRANGEMENT This is a Taipei-based hybrid role. More time at our office in Da’an District will be required during the initial period. When working remotely, you must be able to attend the office with one day’s notice. HOW TO APPLY Please share your resume and any existing work that helps us understand your ideas, personal contribution, and standards. Finished videos are welcome, but a polished portfolio is not required. Drafts, concept sketches, critiques, revision examples, learning records, or concrete achievements can also demonstrate your potential. Tell us briefly why you want to create AI-assisted commercial content and describe one example of something you learned or improved. Applicants without a portfolio should provide other specific evidence of creative drive, learning, and high standards.
